description: A dean of students must approve an emergency residence-hall relocation and support plan for a college student after a serious roommate conflict, with input from the residence life coordinator and counseling center director.

shared_context.S1: A student currently living in Maple Hall has requested an emergency move after a serious roommate conflict.
shared_context.S2: The Dean of Students must approve the student's relocation and associated support plan.
shared_context.S3: The ordinary temporary relocation option for this type of request is Cedar Hall.
shared_context.S4: The student needs a written plan covering the new residence, move timing, contact boundaries, and support follow-up.
shared_context.S5: As part of the standard case-review meeting, the dean asks the residence life coordinator and counseling center director for relevant information before issuing the decision.

PF1.text: Jordan Ellis confirmed with facilities this morning that Cedar Hall is closed for plumbing repairs and that the only available room is in Oak Hall; the room can be occupied Sunday at 4:00 p.m. and is available under a 14-day temporary housing license. The housing dashboard still lists Cedar as available because the closure was posted after its nightly update.

PF2.text: Dr. Priya Nair's completed threat-assessment review requires that the student have no direct or indirect contact with the roommate through May 15, 2026, and receive one counseling check-in each week. She finalized the review after the dean's case summary had already been circulated, so those requirements are not yet in the summary.

acceptance_conditions: The student must be relocated to Oak Hall.
The move must be scheduled for Sunday at 4:00 p.m.
The temporary housing license must last exactly 14 days.
The no-contact requirement must remain in effect through May 15, 2026.
The student must receive exactly one counseling check-in per week.
A housing relocation or coordination commitment must be recorded.
A counseling follow-up or counseling check-in commitment must be recorded.
The counseling requirement must be explicitly justified by the counseling review.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') in ['housing', 'housing_license', 'housing_relocation', 'housing_coordination', 'facility_update', 'dashboard_correction'] or ('Oak Hall' in c.get('detail', '') and ('relocation' in c.get('detail', '') or 'relocated' in c.get('detail', '') or 'relocate' in c.get('detail', '')) ) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') in ['counseling_followup', 'counseling_follow_up', 'counseling_check_in', 'counseling_checkin'] or (c.get('type') == 'written_plan' and 'counseling' in c.get('detail', '') and ('weekly' in c.get('detail', '') or 'per week' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The verified Cedar closure changes the relocation hall to Oak Hall, sets the move for Sunday at 4:00 p.m., fixes the temporary license at exactly 14 days, and supplies the facts required for a housing relocation or coordination commitment.

The completed threat assessment changes the contact boundary to no contact through May 15, 2026, sets counseling at exactly one check-in per week, and requires a counseling follow-up or counseling check-in commitment and explicit citation.
